title: 2.5 The Derivative of the Trigonometric Functions

icans: I can find the derivatives of sine and cosine.
I can find the derivatives of tangent, secant, cotangent, and cosecant.
I can use trig derivatives with the Product and Quotient Rules and to find tangent lines.

vocab: Derivatives of the other trig functions

blocks.p: Estimate the slope of y = sin x.

blocks.sec: Part 2 · Notes and examples (fill in each note, then work the example)

notes: Sine and cosine: d/dx sin x = cos x and d/dx cos x = _______________.

blocks.stem: f(x) = 3 sin x − 2 cos x. Find f′(x) and f′(π/2).
f(x) = x sin x. Find f′(x) and f′(π/2).

notes: Tangent and secant: d/dx tan x = sec²x and d/dx sec x = _______________.

blocks.stem: f(x) = tan x. Find f′(π/3), and the tangent line at (0, 0).

notes: Cotangent and cosecant: d/dx cot x = −csc²x and d/dx csc x = _______________.

blocks.stem: Use the Quotient Rule to show that d/dx csc x = −csc x cot x.
Find the limit as h → 0 of (cos(π/3 + h) − cos(π/3))/h.
f(x) = x cos x. Find f′(π).
